notes: ByteDance Seedance 1.5 Pro on kie.ai, with generated audio (speech from quoted dialogue; kie.ai's model page lists Indonesian). Fields from the raw OpenAPI doc (2026-09-24): prompt, input_urls (0-2 images; 1 = animate this image), aspect_ratio (required, default 1:1, so 9:16 is always sent), resolution, duration (number, 4-12 s), fixed_lens, generate_audio. Priced per second (live pricing 2026-09-24). No character or voice lock. Which durations are accepted inside 4-12 is unverified until a pilot.
